description: This file defines the NotificationService class responsible for scheduling and generating notifications based on event times in a CRM system. It interacts with event and notification repositories, manages notification lifecycle, and uses scheduled methods to trigger notification checks and generation at specific times.

classes.name: NotificationService
classes.description: Service class that manages the creation and scheduling of notifications related to events in the system.

methods.name: NotificationService
methods.description: Constructor injecting event and notification repositories.

methods.name: checkIfGenerateNotification
methods.description: Scheduled method that runs every 5 minutes during working hours to generate or delete notifications based on event times.

methods.name: generateMorningNotifications
methods.description: Scheduled method that runs daily at 8:30 AM to generate initial notifications for the day's events.

methods.name: generateNotification
methods.description: Creates and saves a new notification for a given event.
